stock.description: Safety Godown Company, Limited operates as an investment holding entity, with its primary focus being the rental of investment properties across Hong Kong. The company's business activities are categorized into three main divisions: Godown Operations, Property Investment, and Treasury Investment. Beyond its involvement in managing storage facilities, it also engages in securities trading and other investment ventures. Established in 1960, the firm's headquarters are located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
